Thanks, Kimberly — nice demo yesterday. Quick answers below and attaching our vendor questionnaire.

1) Data roles: Suncrest Pay will act as Controller for customer transaction and PII data. We expect Redwood to act as Processor for any customer data processed on our behalf.

2) SCC preference: we don't have a hard requirement for a particular SCC flavor, but from prior contracts we have relied on an SCC module that preserves Controller decision authority (we can call it "Module IV" for intake). If Redwood can propose the DPA with an SCC arrangement that reflects Suncrest as Controller and Redwood as Processor, that will be fine.

3) SOC 2: We require SOC 2 evidence for providers. Redwood's statement during the call (SOC 2 in progress) is okay for initial evaluation, but for procurement we will request a SOC 2 Type II report once available. Do you have an expected attestation date?

4) Attached: Suncrest_Vendor_SQ.docx (our standard questionnaire, legal@suncrestpay.com included to loop in procurement).
